card.title: Lost and Found - Dino Museum Mystery

metadata.description: Three important fossils have vanished from the Dino Museum just before the grand opening—and your child is the detective on the case. In this interactive audio adventure, kids choose where to dig, uncover hidden artifacts, collect clues, and eliminate suspects to solve the mystery. With no set path, every choice leads the story forward. Perfect for curious kids who love dinosaurs, puzzles, and hands-on play. Printable map required to play.
